verdict.rationale: Dover's own marketing lists "bulk actions" as a Premium ($199/month) feature, so the product does claim bulk operations. It is a single thin mention with no description of what items or actions it covers, and it sits behind a paid tier. missing for 10: documentation of which items and actions support bulk operations, any API or programmatic bulk endpoints, limits and scale, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Premium is $199/month and adds AI applicant scoring, the AI notetaker, offer management with e-signing, bulk actions, and more.
